description:
EnergyIA.AR connects ChatGPT to Argentine energy and mining data taken from official public sources (the energy and mining secretariats, CAMMESA, ENARGAS, INDEC, customs, official gazettes), normalized and up to date.

What you can ask:
- Oil and gas: production by field, basin, formation, province, operator and well; Vaca Muerta area by area; well performance, trajectories and status; drilling and fracking; reserves and upstream investment.
- Refining: the crude each refinery processes and where it comes from.
- Emissions: the official greenhouse-gas inventory, gas flaring and the footprint of producing oil and gas.
- Mining: projects, production and exports by mineral and province.
- Electricity: installed capacity, generation, demand and large consumers.
- Gas network and consumption, the oil value chain and pump prices.
- Energy trade: exports by port and destination, export prices by company, daily gas and crude at the borders, and vessels.
- RIGI investment projects, public tenders and opportunities for suppliers.
- Vigía: status, timeline and figures of key projects; concepts, guides and sector history.

Every answer carries its source, its period and its unit. What is not an official figure comes labelled as such: EnergyIA's own calculations and estimates, market exchange rates (CCL and MEP), vessel positions and satellite estimates. Read-only. Argentina only. Spanish and English. Requires an EnergyIA.AR account.

En español: EnergyIA.AR conecta tu asistente con datos de energía y minería de la Argentina tomados de fuentes públicas oficiales: petróleo y gas por yacimiento, empresa y pozo, Vaca Muerta, refinerías, emisiones y quema de gas, minería, electricidad, gas, exportaciones y precios, proyectos RIGI, licitaciones y el Vigía de grandes proyectos. Cada respuesta cita su fuente, su período y su unidad, y lo que no es oficial (cálculos y estimaciones de EnergyIA, dólar de mercado, posiciones de buques, estimaciones satelitales) va rotulado.

defaultPrompt: Which companies produce the most oil in Argentina?
¿Cuántos pozos se fracturaron en Vaca Muerta el último mes?
What is Argentina's installed power capacity by technology?
